WITH s_products AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    cost,
    category,
    name,
    brand,
    retail_price,
    department,
    sku,
    distribution_center_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products`
  WHERE
    category IN ('Accessories', 'Intimates', 'Women\'s Apparel')
), s_order_items AS (
  SELECT
    oi.id,
    oi.order_id,
    oi.user_id,
    oi.product_id,
    oi.inventory_item_id,
    oi.status,
    oi.created_at,
    oi.shipped_at,
    oi.delivered_at,
    oi.returned_at,
    oi.sale_price
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` AS oi
  JOIN s_products AS sp
    ON sp.id = oi.product_id
), s_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.user_id,
    o.status,
    o.gender,
    o.created_at,
    o.returned_at,
    o.shipped_at,
    o.delivered_at
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders` AS o
  WHERE
    o.order_id IN (
      SELECT
        order_id
      FROM s_order_items
    )
), s_users AS (
  SELECT
    u.id,
    u.age,
    u.gender,
    u.state,
    u.city,
    u.country,
    u.traffic_source,
    u.created_at
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` AS u
)
SELECT
  SUM(sale_price) AS total_revenue
FROM s_order_items
WHERE
  NOT status IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
  AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
LIMIT 1
